integrity: Self-contained proof and standard-library verification program. Two implementations of the fixed point agree on finite prefixes, and enumerated factor classes agree with the theorem through length 192. No independent external scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the canonical binary period-doubling fixed point only. The infinite classification is proved directly by parity and a morphic class bijection; the verification script checks finite lengths through 192. The ordinary cyclic-complexity function at arbitrary lengths is not determined. An unindexed prior equivalent remains possible.
title: Exact Lie complexity of the period-doubling word
